| Library | Version | Source | Licence | File |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cpp-httplib | 0.64.0 (CPPHTTPLIB_VERSION in header; `master` at download time) | https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib | MIT | third_party/httplib/LICENSE |
| nlohmann/json | 3.11.3 | https://github.com/nlohmann/json | MIT | third_party/json/LICENSE.MIT |
| doctest | 2.4.11 | https://github.com/doctest/doctest | MIT | third_party/doctest/LICENSE.txt |
| Plotly.js (plotly.js-dist-min) | 2.35.2 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/plotly.js-dist-min | MIT | app/web/vendor/LICENSE-plotly.txt |

Toolchain used to build: MSYS2 UCRT64 g++ 16.2.0, CMake 4.4.5, Ninja 1.13.2.
